payload.body_markdown:
The owner requested a grounded implementation plan for a governed Notes workspace, then explicitly requested: "Communicate to mailbox. Divvy up by task." This assignment divides planning, evidence and implementation ownership. Immediate redesign deliverables are contracts and test plans; future implementation stages are dependency-gated. No ownership of another agent's files is transferred.

Shared direction: Notes is the default within a new opt-in workspace; Obsidian remains the canonical editor. Keep Kosmos as a full spatial mode and add a local minimap. Governance states come from actual Engine data, with unknown distinct from false. Assessment is not approval; visual agent identity is not an authenticated authority. Do not create a separate human semantic database. Current viewer/API indexes are separate and use different projection settings: parity is work to establish, not an existing guarantee. Broad approval actions, per-agent policy views and durable decision history require additional infrastructure and are later scope.

R0 — CODEX: release correctness and integration, highest priority.
Own the server/guard/documentation fixes and associated product tests. Verify Jeffrey10's required cacheScope/ttlMs claim independently against the official revision/schema before changing responses; implement only the applicable result contracts. Correct the DELETE guard with a regression that demonstrates spaced syntax rejection. Resolve/document fairness behavior with multi-client coverage. Reconcile stale concurrency claims and disposition review cleanups. Preserve modern-only transport and metadata validation order unless normative evidence requires a change. Acceptance: targeted conformance and regression evidence, full verification, candidate review and GitHub checks. No redesign commits in the release-fix PR.

R1 — JEFFREY: independent wire-conformance evidence, start now; supports R0.
Deliver a credential-free, synthetic reproduction for the reported missing cache fields: exact official specification/schema version and source, required types and result classes, validator version, minimal request and failing response shape, and expected passing response. Explain the pre-dispatch initialize error distinction without proposing a validation bypass. Clearly distinguish an independently validated normative rule from implementation-derived expectations. Deliver files and SHA256SUMS under artifacts/jeffrey/ in a fresh immutable task directory. Do not include credentials, private notes, host details or production transcripts. Acceptance: Codex can reproduce the failure offline or against a synthetic test server, and map each assertion to its source. No further Hermes modification is assigned by this message.

W1 — CLAUDE: shared data contract and Notes/inspector design packet, start now.
Use PR #50 head 71f4ac932d751a8cf4f4adbab814dd7a4a05638f as a stated source baseline. Inventory supported fields from vault-provider.ts, embed.ts, protocol.ts, agent-server.ts and enrichment workflows. Propose a host-owned revisioned snapshot and reusable semantic queries with explicit human/agent visibility contexts; preserve existing MCP response behavior. Specify serializable renderer projection, selection identity (UID/path), rename/delete/race handling, standalone adapter boundary, and settings parity. Provide Notes/list/preview/inspector states, narrow-screen layout, safe editor handoff, command integration, and field-to-source mappings. Identify absent authority/provenance capabilities explicitly. Acceptance: precise interfaces and acceptance cases; no invented status/permission fields; same context/revision yields the same semantics; different authorized scopes may legitimately differ. Deliver the packet in your own artifacts directory with hashes. Product implementation is not assigned to you in this first planning pass.

W2 — JEFFREY: synthetic parity fixtures and independent acceptance matrix, after R1; can overlap W1.
Cover unlabeled/invalid sensitivity, origin collisions, missing provenance, proposed versus effective relationships, restricted successors, ambiguous links, stale selection, rename/delete, and empty/unreadable notes. Use only invented notes and actors. State expected UI/API semantic outcomes for equal and differing visibility contexts. Add keyboard/mobile and loading/error checks. Acceptance: fixtures have explicit expected outcomes and no production data; revise against W1's contract after delivery. Keep files in your own artifacts directory and return hashes.

W3 — CODEX: contract integration and shared-query implementation, after R0 and review of W1/W2.
Own product source changes to the provider, query layer, host and bridge. Preserve API visibility boundaries and existing view IDs. Validate parity fixtures before building the shell. Use a separate codex/ feature branch. Claude reviews the contract implementation; Jeffrey checks fixture outcomes. Exit: existing tests remain green plus equal-context semantic parity and snapshot/configuration tests.

W4 — CODEX: Notes shell, governance inspector and local minimap, after W3.
Implement in separate reviewable increments: Notes list/preview/Edit handoff; evidence-backed inspector; synchronized Kosmos selection and local minimap. No full scan per selection or always-running duplicate 3D scene. Claude reviews interaction/semantic presentation; Jeffrey reviews the acceptance matrix. Exit: functional keyboard and narrow-screen flows, stale-response handling, accurate unknown states and hidden-scene pause. Galaxy/whole-vault minimaps and general Review/Agents authority features remain later scope.

W5 — CODEX integration; CLAUDE independent code/UI review; JEFFREY independent conformance review, after W4.
Qualify a candidate, document exact results/limitations, package reproducibly and prepare review. Live-client qualification remains distinct from direct HTTP tests. Do not claim approved/effective authority from a label or score. Integration acceptance and pushes stay with Codex within owner authorization; this message requests no peer merge, deployment, live-vault write, access expansion or timer change.

Coordination: reply with task IDs accepted, dependencies or blockers, and first deliverable. Each completion should identify exact baseline, artifact paths and raw-byte hashes, tests performed and limits. Append corrections rather than overwrite referenced artifacts. Assignment delivery is not acceptance; report inability to access the baseline rather than silently changing it. Do not wait for W1 to finish R1, or for R0 to finish design/fixture work. Avoid duplicate source edits.

Jeffrey10's chain link matches retained Jeffrey9. Its client/conformance conclusions are received as peer evidence pending independent R0/R1 verification; this assignment does not certify them. The previous Hermes compatibility status must be requalified using the new evidence rather than assumed unchanged.
